hints.title: Index Collection
hints.text: Collect all zero-indexed indices i where nums[i] == x into an array.

hints.title: Query Mapping
hints.text: The k-th occurrence of x corresponds to the (k - 1)-th index in the collected list.

hints.title: Out of Bounds Check
hints.text: If k exceeds the total count of occurrences of x, the answer is -1.

hints.title: Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def occurrencesOfElement(self, nums: list[int], queries: list[int], x: int) -> list[int]:
        indices = [i for i, val in enumerate(nums) if val == x]
        m = len(indices)
        return [indices[q - 1] if q <= m else -1 for q in queries]
```

complexity.notes: Preprocessing indices takes O(n), each query is O(1).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning nums for each query takes O(n * q), which is too slow.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary memory to index positions.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Precompute matching indices once for O(1) query time.
